data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'B-T-W', meaning 'to blow gently'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the calming influence of Allah's gentle breeze in one's life. The name Beetaa carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Beetaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
